topic: The Rhythm of Heat: From Circles to Fourier Series

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Geometry of Oscillation
lecture_lines: Circular motion creates simple harmonic waves.
A point rotates at a constant speed.
The shadow traces a sine wave.
This projection links angles to waves.
animations: Place point P on circle, #FF5733. Label 'P'.
Animate P moving along circle, #FF5733. Trace path.
Show projection to y-axis as height, #33FF57. Label 'sin(t)'.
Animate sin(t) plotting against time, #33FF57. Label 'Sine Wave'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/metronome.svg]

sections.title: Fourier's Core Concept: Building Complexity
lecture_lines: Sum multiple sine waves of varying frequencies.
Small rotations combine into larger patterns.
Epicycles stack to trace complex silhouettes.
Any curve emerges from simple circles.
animations: Display single sine wave, frequency f, #3498DB. Label 'A'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pendulum.svg]
Superimpose A and B to form new shape, #9B59B6.
Show total summation of waves as complex wave, #F1C40F. Label 'Sum'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/motor.svg]

sections.title: Bridging to the Heat Equation
lecture_lines: The heat equation models thermal diffusion.
Temperature distributes along the metal rod.
animations: Show temperature distribution as function u(x, t) along the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rod.svg]. #FFFFFF.
Represent heat flow using derivative notation across the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rod.svg], #E67E22. Label 'Heat Flow'.
Animate spatial profile flattening over time within the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rod.svg], #3498DB. Label 'Diffusion'.

sections.title: Application: Thermal Diffusion in a Ring
lecture_lines: Heat flows naturally within a ring.
Boundary conditions simplify circular thermal flow.
Fourier series describe steady temperature states.
animations: Illustrate circular wire [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wire.svg] with ring icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ring.svg] and heat source, #E74C3C. Label 'Ring'.
Show heat diffusing clockwise and counter-clockwise along the wire [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wire.svg], #3498DB. Arrows.
Display periodic boundary condition u(0,t)=u(L,t) on the ring [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ring.svg], #2ECC71. Label 'Boundary'.

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis
lecture_lines: Circles generate waves, forming Fourier series.
Series solve complex heat diffusion problems.
Heat flow acts as frequency harmonics.
animations: Display unit circle connected to sine waves, #FFFFFF. Label 'Waves'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg]
Show transition to heat equation components, #3498DB. Label 'Heat'.
Summarize the synthesis of frequency in space, #F1C40F. Label 'Conclusion'. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/radiator.svg]
